The Commissioner has granted a two-game roster exemption for Rams DT Aaron Donald, who was officially reinstated to the active roster today. The roster exemption will expire on Friday, Sept. 11.
Details of all 15 cutdown-day trades:
The Lions placed DBs Brian Branch and Kerby Joseph on reserve/PUP and C Cade Mays on injured reserve/designated for return. They're all out at least four games.
The Seahawks released CB Trevon Diggs, but plan to bring him back on the practice squad, per source.
The Steelers activated CB Joey Porter Jr. from the PUP list.
The Cardinals placed veteran RB James Conner on injured reserve/designated to return. He'll miss at least the first four games.

The Lions are waiving rookie QB Luke Altmyer, per source.

Detroit wants Altmyer back on the practice squad if he clears waivers. But veteran Josh Dobbs will back up Jared Goff.
Plot twist: The Vikings are trading Walter Rouse and a 2027 7th-round pick to the Patriots for a 2027 6th-round pick.
The Lions are releasing veteran WR Greg Dortch, per source.

Vikings OLB Tyler Batty suffered a torn ACL in Friday’s preseason finale and is going on injured reserve, per sources. 

Batty was slated to be a key rotational player. Instead, he’s out for the season.
Trade! The Texans are sending OL Jarrett Patterson to the 49ers, sources tell @ringer @netflixsports.

The Chargers are waiving QB DJ Uiagalelei, sources say. 

They want to bring him back on the practice squad if he clears waivers. So, Trey Lance is in line for another season as Justin Herbert’s top backup.

A Legend Returns: Ten-time Pro Bowl DT Aaron Donald is coming out of retirement to play for the Rams this season, sources tell @ringer @netflixsports. 

Donald last played in 2023 and is 35 years old. But he’s back for one more run, now alongside fellow superstar Myles Garrett.
The Commanders are waiving QB Sam Hartman, but would like him to return on the practice squad, per source.
The Cowboys are waiving 2025 seventh-round pick DT Jay Toia, per source.
The Titans are waiving QB Will Levis, sources tell @ringer @netflixsports.

Trade! The Chargers are sending rookie CB Avery Smith to the Seahawks for a 2027 sixth-round pick, per sources.

A former Toledo standout, Smith can play nickel and now gets an opportunity in Seattle.

No other players are expected to land on the commissioner's exempt list today, per sources.

All other cases remain under review. But three will start the season on paid leave: Packers RB Josh Jacobs, Broncos OLB Jonathan Cooper and new Seahawks CB Terrion Arnold.
